goal: Dark theme only, offline walk and DESIGN.md check (T7; Board gate 190: T7 removes the prefers-color-scheme listener): finish theme tokens and verify AC-83, AC-84, AC-86, AC-87.

acceptance_criteria.text: databoot.css has no 'prefers-color-scheme', no '@font-face', and holds #050a12, #4de1ff, #ffb454, a monospace system font stack and color-scheme: dark; dashboard.js has no matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)') variable or listener (only the phone query is kept) and charts read the dark tokens through tokens() whatever the emulated OS scheme

Playwright (tests/test_theme_round7.py): with emulated color scheme light and dark, body background computes to rgb(5, 10, 18) and the cyan/amber tokens resolve; body and label text keep contrast >= 4.5:1 against the effective tile background; charts keep one y-axis and bars sorted from zero (existing checks still green); token-reading tests (AC-50 --div-mid, AC-69, test_table_toggle) are re-run and pass

Offline walk (AC-86): one Playwright test records every request while it opens /, uploads files, waits for /scan, opens the workspace, drags and expands/closes a tile, toggles a table view and filters inside the overlay; all requests go to the app's own host

AC-87: a text test reads docs/DESIGN.md: a heading containing 'round 7' whose section lists #050a12, #4de1ff, #ffb454, 'mono', 'header', 'drag handle', 'expand', 'table toggle', '12-column', '0.6 s', 'reduced motion' and 'reduced transparency'; the section is edited only if a term is missing, and says the portal rings always turn (Board gate 190)
The full pytest suite is run once at the end, alone, and its result reported; failures are fixed in the app, not in tests/test_acceptance.py
Moves acceptance items AC-83, AC-84, AC-86, AC-87 forward

decisions.what: Made no code or test change in attempt 3; attempt 1's commit (6047d2a) already holds the dashboard.js listener removal, the DESIGN.md wording, tests/test_theme_round7.py and tests/test_round7_offline.py
decisions.why: Every acceptance line is met and the full suite passes, so rebuilding would only add risk
decisions.evidence: git log --stat -3; pytest tests/test_theme_round7.py tests/test_round7_offline.py tests/test_table_toggle.py (11 passed); full python -m pytest -q: 480 passed in 739.16s

decisions.what: Checked the workspace in a real browser at 1280 and 375 wide
decisions.why: Role rule: look at the pages; the dark tokens, cyan titles and amber chip render with no console errors

tried_and_failed.what: Finding why attempts 1 and 2 failed verify
tried_and_failed.why_it_failed: Their handovers carry an empty output_tail and the run folders have no verify log; the most likely cause is a timing test under load (attempt 2 saw test_AC_42 fail at its 5 s cold limit)

assumptions: The earlier verify failures were load-dependent timing or hover flakes in tests/test_acceptance.py, not this ticket's code, because a clean full run now passes
open_questions: The offline walk triggers the overlay filter with plotly_click from script, not a real mouse click on a bar; say if AC-86 needs a real pointer click
test_AC_42 (5.0 s cold limit) has little margin under load; QA may want to review it since tests/test_acceptance.py is protected

lessons.lesson: On a retry with committed work and an empty verify tail, run the ticket's tests, then the full suite once in the background with a 2,400,000 ms timeout, and poll the log with a loop of 5 s sleeps instead of starting a second run
lessons.when: Retry tickets whose earlier verify failed with no output

lessons.lesson: Do not kill a server by scanning /proc cmdlines for the port string: the scanning shell matches itself and dies (exit 144). Start the server with a known PID file instead
lessons.when: Stopping a local app started with nohup in an image without pkill or curl
lessons.evidence: exit code 144 on the kill loop
